patch_description: Crossover of the best-performing program (Powell softmax annealing, score 0.82) with the current program (active-set soft-min objective, L-BFGS, fast). Key combination ideas: (1) adopt the Powell optimizer with temperature annealing schedule from the highest-scoring script, since it achieved the best min-area; (2) keep the active-set bottom-k soft-min restriction from the current program, which sharpens the gradient signal on the binding constraints; (3) use the softmax parametrization (guaranteed feasibility, smooth) as in the Powell script, but seed starts from the current program's hand-designed symmetric seed and mirror-paired perturbations; (4) add a short L-BFGS-B polish pass at the final temperature for cheap local refinement; (5) keep the strict positive-area guard with rescue restarts and the non-degenerate hardcoded fallback. Determinism preserved via fixed seeds and deterministic starts.
